headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 6, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets edged out the Atlanta Braves in a thrilling 10-9 victory, with Drake Baldwin leading the Mets' offense. In other action, the Pittsburgh Pirates took down the Washington Nationals 11-5, while the Cincinnati Reds secured a crucial win over the Baltimore Orioles. The Minnesota Twins also secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. Other notable injuries include Tomoyuki Sugano (Colorado Rockies) and Seth Halvorsen (Colorado Rockies) due to back spasms and right shoulder inflammation, respectively.

The Cleveland Guardians made a trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for cash. The Washington Nationals also made a trade, acquiring left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove from the Houston Astros in exchange for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Edge Braves in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets outlasted the Atlanta Braves in a back-and-forth contest, ultimately securing a 10-9 win. Drake Baldwin led the Mets' offense with a strong performance, collecting 2 hits, including a home run, and driving in 4 runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Nationals 11-5**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 11-5 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Brandon Lowe leading the offense. Lowe's strong performance included a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Orioles in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Baltimore Orioles 3-2, securing a crucial win. Spencer Steer led the Reds' offense with a home run and two RBIs, while Nick Lodolo pitched six strong innings, earning the win.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Yankees 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 6-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Joe Ryan earning the win after pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Brandon Woodruff Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-hander Brandon Woodruff has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right shoulder inflammation. This move comes on July 5, 2026.

top_news.title: **Degges Joins Guardians**
top_news.summary: Ryan Degges has been traded to the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for cash. The move comes after the Philadelphia Phillies dealt the right-handed pitcher to the Guardians.
